contract.missing_callback: unregister() returns False when the requested callback is not registered
contract.missing_event: unregister() returns False when the requested event has no registered listener
contract.registry_stability: Unregister attempts for nonexistent listeners or events do not modify the existing listener registry
contract.callback_isolation: A nonexistent callback removal attempt does not affect registered callbacks
contract.post_attempt_delivery: Registered callbacks continue receiving emitted events after unsuccessful unregister attempts
contract.missing_callback_delivery: An unregistered callback receives no emitted events
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister and emit operations continue to require the events permission
